ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section 00U - Edith Wharton and Her Times This class will focus on major U.S. author Edith Wharton (1862-1937), whose 19 novels and novellas and 11 short story collections created a career devoted to what one of her biographers calls ?the social chronicler of her age.? We will start with her short stories: some about love and romance (?Roman Fever?), some about personal careers (?The Other Two?), and others about social comedy (?Xingu?). Over the course of the semester, we will read a few of her most famous novels, including The House of Mirth (1905), from her illustrious career. Many films have been based on her works, and we will be comparing a few of them to the literary works themselves. Assignments for this course will include the following: short responses to Wharton?s writing, a focused paper on the cultural history (5 pages), a midterm and a final.
